verdict.rationale: Trello is a SaaS board tool, so it has no headless binary to run. It does offer a REST API with API-key and user-token auth (configurable expiry and scopes) plus Batch, Search and Webhooks endpoints, so scripts and CI jobs can drive it without the UI. There is no first-party CLI or documented CI integration, and probes found no public OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: official CLI or headless runner, CI/pipeline guidance or examples, service-account/non-interactive token docs, published OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration.
